# PR-Triggered Workflow Trust Boundary Checklist

[Back to Workflow Authoring Reference](AUTHORING.md#pr-triggered-workflow-trust-boundary-checklist)

Apply this checklist before the first push of any PR-triggered workflow or composite action change. Each item is a judgment question; where a mechanical enforcer exists it is named so you can run it locally (commits are free, pushes are expensive — see [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)).

- **Untrusted PR code execution** — does any job check out PR-head code and then _execute_ it (build/test/run scripts) in a context that holds secrets or a write token? If so, gate the job behind the trusted-secret-context flag (`trusted-secret-context` as a `ci.yml` output; `trusted_secret_context` as a `workflow_call` input) or treat the PR as untrusted and skip the sensitive steps. Wiring: `__tests__/secret-context.*` (automated).
- **Privileged dependency repair** — keep the immutable base checkout as the only executable tree. PR manifests and locks may be fetched by SHA and parsed as data, but never run through SwiftPM, package plugins, MSBuild, shell helpers, or repository scripts. A publisher may check out an already-validated PR head solely to apply a fixed regular-file artifact and create a non-force commit; it must revalidate identity, base, head, changed-file allowlist, provenance, and hashes immediately before the push.
- **Local action / composite checkout source** — when invoking a local composite action or reusable workflow, check it out from the _trusted base ref_ (`pull_request.base.sha`) into a separate path rather than from PR head. Pass the trusted ref explicitly so the action's prompts or scripts also come from the base ref. (judgment)
- **Runner isolation** — PR jobs use fresh GitHub-hosted runners from the repository's closed label allowlist. Do not introduce self-hosted PR execution without updating the threat model for cross-run workspace contamination. Runner label enforcement: `runner-policy.test.mts`; contamination judgment: yours.
- **`GITHUB_TOKEN` permissions** — set least privilege at the job that needs each grant. Local reusable-workflow calls must declare explicit job-level permissions exactly equal to the union required by the callee; `workflow-permissions.test.mts` rejects both undergrants and overgrants.
- **Required-gate behavior on skip / `continue-on-error`** — fan-in gates must use `!cancelled()` + explicit `result == 'success' || result == 'skipped'` checks, never bare `always()`. If a leaf job is `continue-on-error: true`, confirm that the gate still passes the right gate_status when that job fails. Enforced by `ci-aggregate-gates.test.mts`.
- **Reusable-workflow contracts** — `workflow_call` inputs and required/undefined secrets at `uses:` are validated by **actionlint** on every workflow change (run `actionlint -shellcheck=""` locally). Additionally confirm that `secrets: inherit` passes only what the callee actually declares. (actionlint)
- **Workflow security audit** — run `zizmor --offline --min-severity high --min-confidence high .`. [`.github/zizmor.yml`](../zizmor.yml) contains only durable pinning policy; central `rules.*.ignore` arrays are forbidden because they are positional and silently drift as files change. Resolve findings by narrowing jobs first. If a finding is genuinely irreducible, use an inline Zizmor suppression beside the construct with a rationale. (zizmor)
- **Remote action pins** — every remote `uses:` must be a 40-hex commit SHA with a `# vX` version comment, including `actions/*` and `github/*`. Resolve tags with `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/commits/<tag> --jq .sha` so annotated tags yield a runnable commit, not a tag-object SHA. Shape enforcement: `pnpm run no-mistakes` (`github-actions-pinned-hash`). Resolvability: CI fails on the first run.
- **Script consolidation behavior preservation** — when merging or deleting `ci/*.sh`/`ci/*.mts` scripts, verify that missing-`needs` producer detection, failed/cancelled producer gating, skipped-producer handling, and flat single-artifact normalization are each still covered by tests. Existing cases: `ci/__tests__/workflow-scripts.test.mts` and `workflow-scripts.part-2.test.mts`.
